render_prompts.full_prompt: The scene opens with a medium close-up on the weathered, wise hands of an elderly Indian architect, his skin a tapestry of wrinkles and age spots. He is seated at a heavy, rustic sheesham wood desk within a sun-drenched Jaipur courtyard. Volumetric shafts of golden late-afternoon sunlight cut through the hazy air, illuminating swirling motes of dust. In the background, the intricate, rose-colored sandstone carvings of a Rajasthani palace are visible, softened by a shallow depth of field. The camera performs a slow, macro push-in, following the tip of a charcoal stick held in the architect's hand as it glides across a sheet of thick, fibrous, cream-colored parchment. The charcoal leaves a dark, textured line, its particles smudging slightly against the paper's grain as it forms the elegant, parabolic curve of a traditional Jharokha arch. As the final stroke connects, the camera's forward motion continues, moving past the hand and focusing entirely on the drawing. The real-world background dissolves into a warm, abstract bokeh. A moment later, the area enclosed by the charcoal line and the implied horizontal axis begins to emanate a soft, internal golden light. This luminescence is not cast upon the paper but seems to well up from within its very fibers, growing from a faint shimmer to a steady, contained, volumetric glow. Following this, the glowing space begins to fill with a mesmerizing tessellation of miniature blue tiles. These tiles materialize with a liquid-like grace, each one rendered with photorealistic detail: a glossy, deep cobalt blue ceramic surface with subtle crazing that catches and reflects the internal golden light. They shimmer and shift as they seamlessly pack together, perfectly occupying the entire area under the curve, transforming the abstract space into a tangible, beautiful mosaic.

render_prompts.full_prompt: The scene transitions to an extreme close-up, top-down perspective of the architect's parchment. The intricate blue tiles have vanished, leaving only the dark charcoal line of the arch and the solid, warm golden glow filling the area beneath it. The camera is static, allowing the viewer to appreciate the highly detailed, fibrous texture of the handmade paper. Suddenly, a series of five large, vertical, rectangular blocks of brilliant white-gold light materialize within the glowing area. These blocks are volumetric and slightly hazy at the edges, casting sharp, localized highlights and micro-shadows on the paper fibers around them. Their formation is clumsy, creating a coarse, jagged, stepped approximation of the arch's smooth curve, with significant dark gaps visible between their upper edges and the charcoal line. A moment later, a seamless and fluid animation begins. The large, clumsy blocks dissolve into a shower of much smaller, thinner rectangular columns of light. This is not a cut, but a smooth, continuous transformation. The number of light columns multiplies exponentially, and as they become progressively narrower, their collective shape hugs the charcoal curve with ever-increasing accuracy. The camera executes an almost imperceptible, slow dolly-in, magnifying the process and emphasizing how the jagged gaps are shrinking into non-existence. The motion is like a cascade of liquid light being meticulously reshaped. The refinement process accelerates, the columns becoming as thin as threads of light, their stepped edges blurring into a smooth, continuous contour. The animation concludes as the individual blocks merge into a single, flawless, solid field of luminescence that perfectly fills the area, its light softening back to the gentle, warm golden hue from the beginning, pulsing with a soft, steady rhythm.

render_prompts.full_prompt: The scene cuts to a wider shot, revealing the architect's hands carefully unrolling an ancient scroll across the dark wood of his desk. The scroll is made of a brittle, yellowed papyrus, its edges frayed and its surface marked with the stains of time. As it is fully unfurled, the camera cranes down and pushes in towards its center. In the middle of the scroll, a single, elegant mathematical formula is written in a sweeping, calligraphic style with dark ink. This formula begins to glow from within, the ink itself becoming a source of soft, contained golden light. Subtle volumetric rays emanate from the glowing symbols, silhouetting the surrounding ancient text and casting a warm light upon the scroll's textured surface. The camera then performs a slow, graceful rack focus and pan to the right. As the glowing formula on the scroll blurs into a soft, golden bokeh in the background, the parchment drawing of the Jharokha arch, lying beside it, snaps into sharp focus. A single, shimmering mote of golden light detaches from the blurred formula and drifts lazily through the air toward the drawing. Upon making contact with the starting point of the charcoal arch, it erupts into a brilliant, thin line of molten gold energy. This incandescent thread begins to trace the exact path of the charcoal curve with perfect, unwavering precision and a confident, steady speed. It moves with a flawless, fluid grace, leaving a faint, fading trail of light particles in its wake. As the energy line reaches the end of the curve, it flares brightly for a brief moment before dissipating into a thousand tiny, upward-drifting sparks, leaving the original charcoal drawing pristine and untouched.

render_prompts.full_prompt: The scene holds on a close-up of the parchment drawing. The architect's weathered hand enters the frame, his index finger moving with deliberate grace to touch the exact starting point of the arch's base on the left. As his fingertip makes contact, a single, elegant letter 'a', composed of soft, volumetric white light, materializes on the paper. The light casts a gentle glow onto his skin. He then slowly traces the flat baseline under the arch, the camera tracking his finger's movement across the fibrous paper. When his finger reaches the end of the arch's base on the right, he taps the paper again, and a glowing letter 'b' materializes, identical in style to the 'a', marking the interval's boundaries. The architect lifts his hand away. As he does, two ethereal, three-dimensional numerical values coalesce in the air above the drawing. Above the glowing 'b', a value composed of swirling particles of golden light forms into a volumetric, semi-transparent number. Simultaneously, above the glowing 'a', a similar number forms, but composed of a cooler, silver light. These light-sculptures hover and gently rotate. The architect then brings his hands together in a symbolic gesture, cupping the space between the two floating numbers. This action creates an invisible force, pulling the two ethereal numbers from their positions towards the center, directly over the arch. The silver number drifts into and merges with the golden one. This causes a brilliant flash, and the golden number visibly diminishes in size, as if the silver value has been perfectly subtracted from it. The result is a single, new numerical value, glowing with a pure, triumphant golden light. This final number floats majestically for a moment before slowly dissolving into a cascade of upward-drifting motes of light.

render_prompts.full_prompt: The scene dissolves from the ethereal numbers to a breathtaking, photorealistic, cinematic shot. Initially, the frame is filled with the intricate detail of a real-life, physical Jharokha archway at sunset. The arch is constructed from warm, rose-colored sandstone, its surface showing a rough, grainy texture, weathered by centuries of sun and monsoon. The space beneath the arch is a stunning mosaic of deep cobalt blue and turquoise ceramic tiles, their high-gloss finish catching the last rays of the setting sun, causing them to shimmer with fiery orange and gold reflections. The lighting is pure magic hour, bathing the entire structure in a warm, saturated, golden-orange hue and casting long, soft shadows. The camera then commences a very slow, majestic pull-back, a smooth combination of a dolly-out and a crane-up. As it moves, the full, elegant form of the Jharokha is revealed, including its delicate latticework jali screen and ornate supporting brackets. The continuous pull-back reveals that this arch is not an isolated element but a perfect component of the grand facade of a magnificent Rajasthani palace. More domes, chhatris, and arches come into view, all glowing under the sunset. The palace is revealed to be situated beside a vast, serene lake, its still surface acting as a perfect mirror, reflecting the fiery colors of the sky and the dark silhouette of the colossal structure. The camera movement concludes on an epic wide shot, framing the entire palace against a dramatic sky streaked with vibrant orange, deep purple, and crimson clouds. The sun, a perfect orb, touches the horizon. The final image is one of profound awe and tangible accomplishment, holding for several seconds before a slow fade to black.
